nodes.text: Finite version of the paper’s fan–replicator rule. Port identities, not geometric sides, determine the reconnection: (Fᵢ)ⱼ ↔ (Rʲ)ᵢ. This guide-specific diagram uses a three-port replicator so every copy has a visible port and wire. It adapts the structure of [Figure 4 in the source paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.20314v4#S2.F4) (CC BY 4.0).
